blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Schools may independently suspend in-person classes based on safety risks within their premises and seek to resume face-to-face learning even while a local government-ordered suspension remains in effect, under a new policy issued by President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. Executive Order (EO) No. 130, signed on Oct. 28 but published only on Tuesday, establishes a three-tier framework for suspending and resuming classes, activities, and on-site work in public and private educational institutions and learning centers.
